name: manifold_benchmark_binary_filtered
description: A curated suite of binary classification benchmarks assembled from the Manifold benchmark collection and filtered to reduce label noise and artifacts. It is intended to evaluate binary predictive performance, robustness, and calibration of models across heterogeneous datasets and feature distributions. The benchmark enables comparisons of standard classifiers and downstream evaluation of how filtering and data manifold structure affect binary decision boundaries.
reputation: A small, niche benchmark hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing adoption among researchers exploring binary classification and dataset-quality effects.
